items.title: Sony Is Updating The PS5 Again, And It Might Have GTA 6 Pirates In Mind
items.summary: A new PS5 firmware update has dropped, but even at a chunky 1.2GB download, version 26.07-14.23.00 doesn't include a comprehensive list of notes. "We've made some security fixes to the system software," the very short update notes read . Notably, this is the fourth PS5 firmware update since October 1 , and typically there's a buffer period of several months between downloads. While Sony hasn't confirmed it, the current thinking is that the company is shoring up its defenses for the release of GTA 6 to prevent the game from being pirated. items.title: Microsoft's SideWinder Strategic Commander was a failed attempt to reimagine RTS controls. 23 years later, why are some players still using it?
items.summary: PC players have been conditioned for decades to accept the keyboard-and-mouse setup for RTS games . One hand has to handle movement and commands through a keyboard, while the other points, drags, and selects with a mouse. Peripheral makers have, usually with the addition of more buttons, made many minor variations to this time-honored arrangement, but there's only ever been one real attempt to rethink it entirely for the PC: the Microsoft SideWinder Strategic Commander.
